newsitem.title: UK: UK's TransCo to interrupt gas in five areas on Wed.
newsitem.headline: UK's TransCo to interrupt gas in five areas on Wed.

text.p: British Gas Plc's pipeline and distribution division TransCo said on Tuesday that holders of interruptible gas contracts in five Local Distribution Zones (LDZs) will face full interruptions on Wednesday.

The five LDZs are -- North Thames; South East; Southern; South West; and South Wales. A further five LDZs in the North and Midlands will face limited interruptions to Network Sensitive Loads, a TransCo spokesman said.
On Monday, TransCo's throughput of gas was 344 million cubic metres. This compares with the record of 388 million cubic metres carried on 20 February last year.
